planetary_events.name: The Blooming Tide (Ionospheric Chorus)
planetary_events.gameplay_effect: All bioluminescent flora pulses in visible harmonic waves; unlocks Choir Root-Nerve alignment; scrambles unshielded radio electronics.
planetary_events.visual_audio: Aurora bands sweep twilight sky; bass harmonic drone resonates through ground.

planetary_events.name: Piezoelectric Ion Tempest
planetary_events.gameplay_effect: Lightning strikes exposed metal gear unless sheltering beneath Grounding Storm-Ferns, Reedwood Arches, or Field Camp; supercharges Voltaic Beetles; triggers post-storm Verdigris Copper-Blooms in dry canyons.
planetary_events.visual_audio: Singing Reedwoods shift from major to urgent minor howling 60s before onset; cyan fork arcs flash crisp pixel silhouettes.

planetary_events.name: Vitreous Acid Mist
planetary_events.gameplay_effect: Drains suit filter envelope in low basins; forces elevated root-arch routes or Breath-Sponge filter; increases Reed-Fang Lurker ambush range.
planetary_events.visual_audio: Low emerald ground-fog rolls across water; hissing sizzle on suit visor.

planetary_events.name: Vesper Spore-Fall
planetary_events.gameplay_effect: Reduces visibility & triggers mild Neuro-Static without mask; forces shelter beneath Umbrella-Fungi; triggers nocturnal Dusk-Stalker hunts.
planetary_events.visual_audio: Drifting teal-gold glowing snowflakes; soft percussive pattering on giant mushroom caps.

planetary_events.name: Twin-Moon Syzygy Tide
planetary_events.gameplay_effect: Extreme low tide exposes Sunken Monolith Shoals & wreck salvage for 6 minutes; extreme high tide lifts Float-Bladder Bridges to cliff ledges!
planetary_events.visual_audio: Twin moons align visibly in water reflections; rhythmic deep surf rumble.

planetary_events.name: Zenith Heat Scour
planetary_events.gameplay_effect: Accelerates thermal drain in open sunlight; wildlife retreats underground; encourages twilight/night desert expeditions & Mirage Wax-Barrel balm.
planetary_events.visual_audio: Shimmering heat-haze shader distortion; cicada-like dry mineral clicks.

planetary_events.name: Magnetic Aurora Whiteout
planetary_events.gameplay_effect: Severe cold drain outside geothermal pockets; ONLY time Aurora Ice-Lotus unfolds for harvesting; compass needle drifts toward magnetic veins.
planetary_events.visual_audio: Curtains of green-violet pixel ribbons across sky; howling wind drops to eerie calm inside snow caves.

planetary_events.name: Subterranean Choir Tremor
planetary_events.gameplay_effect: Opens temporary crystal fissures revealing echo minerals; causes Root-Weavers to swarm outward repairing Choir nerves.
planetary_events.visual_audio: Subtle camera trauma pulse; crystalline wind-chime resonance echoing through caves.
